about_short_description.short_description: Sola is a natural disaster insurance company that offers data-driven property insurance policies.

product.name: Sola Wind and Hail Insurance
product.description: A standalone residential insurance policy that provides payouts for covered wind, hail, and tornado damage, including high deductibles and roof depreciation gaps left by homeowners insurance.

product.name: Sola Claims Administration
product.description: A claims service for submitting and tracking wind, hail, and tornado claims, using weather data and photo documentation to assess covered events and issue payouts.

product.name: Independent Agent Partner Program
product.description: A distribution and support program that enables independent insurance agents to quote and sell Sola standalone wind and hail policies alongside homeowners insurance.

identifier.value: Mortgage Lender API Quoting and Integration

product.name: Mortgage Lender API Quoting and Integration
product.description: An API-based service for mortgage lenders and servicers to quote Sola coverage for borrowers and connect policy, loan, and claims workflows to existing systems.

product.name: Member Policy Self-Service Portal
product.description: An online portal for Sola policyholders to make payments, access policy documents, submit or track claims, and manage policy-related information.
